title: Climate, Peace and Security Assessment: Papua New Guinea
organization: adelphi research / Weathering Risk, with Asian Development Bank and United Nations Development Programme
temporal_coverage: Historical and current conditions with SSP projections through 2100.
methodology: Mixed-method climate-security assessment combining literature, climate-risk analysis, interviews, workshops, expert interpretation, and regional case studies.
limitations: The synthesis does not causally identify most pathways; some findings are locality-specific and projection uncertainty remains.

title: Papua New Guinea's Enhanced Nationally Determined Contribution 2020
organization: Government of Papua New Guinea and Climate Change and Development Authority
temporal_coverage: Policy targets and information needs mainly through 2030.
methodology: Government policy submission presenting sector baselines, consultations, quantified adaptation targets, and stated information gaps.
limitations: Targets are intended commitments rather than evaluated implementation; the document predates later policy and hazard developments.

title: Papua New Guinea: Technical Assistance Report - Climate Policy Diagnostic
temporal_coverage: Diagnostic mission in July 2024 and policy status through publication.
methodology: A fiscal and institutional diagnostic based on desk review, a government mission, consultations, and sector analysis.
limitations: Not an FCV study; historical climate series have gaps and recommendations are not implementation outcomes.

title: Assessing the Evidence: Migration, Environment and Climate Change in Papua New Guinea
temporal_coverage: Migration and displacement evidence available through 2014.
methodology: A literature review supplemented by six key-informant interviews and technical working-group feedback.
limitations: Older and largely secondary evidence; volcanic, development, and climate-related mobility drivers must remain distinct.

title: Beyond Barriers: Papua New Guinea Case Study
organization: Humanitarian Advisory Group and World Vision / Australian Humanitarian Partnership
geographic_coverage: Four communities and relevant provincial and national institutions
methodology: Review of more than 20 documents, eight interviews, 12 focus groups, and 167 community participants.
limitations: A four-community qualitative sample cannot represent all provinces or customary settings and is not an outcome evaluation.

title: Implementation Completion Report Review: Rural Service Delivery and Local Governance (P126157)
geographic_coverage: Eight pilot local-level governments in two provinces
temporal_coverage: Project implementation and inspection shortly after closure.
methodology: Independent review of completion evidence, performance indicators, project records, and reported site inspections.
limitations: Project-specific and geographically narrow; weak monitoring and short follow-up constrain attribution and sustainability assessment.

title: Evaluation of the UNDP Papua New Guinea Country Programme 2018-2022
methodology: Independent evaluation using document review, interviews, field visits, triangulation, and OECD-DAC-oriented criteria.
limitations: Limited interviews and field provinces; some climate-policy products were incomplete or too recent for outcome assessment.

title: Food Assistance to El Nino Affected Populations in Papua New Guinea
geographic_coverage: Affected local-level governments in Papua New Guinea
temporal_coverage: 2015-2016 El Nino drought and frost episode.
methodology: Operational assessment drawing on mobile vulnerability analysis and mapping with the National Disaster Centre.
limitations: Implementing-agency evidence, not an independent or nationally representative evaluation; findings apply to assessed affected areas.

title: Common Country Analysis 2024 Update
organization: United Nations Resident Coordinator's Office in Papua New Guinea
geographic_coverage: Papua New Guinea, with subnational examples
temporal_coverage: Conditions and UN analysis available through 2024.
methodology: A UN country-team desk synthesis incorporating country evidence and expert inputs.
limitations: Secondary expert synthesis rather than causal analysis; national aggregation obscures provincial and ecological differences.

title: Taking Locally Led Climate and Security Actions Seriously in Papua New Guinea
geographic_coverage: Papua New Guinea, with selected local and provincial inquiry
methodology: Desk review, interviews, participatory workshop, and locally led climate-security analysis.
limitations: Limited province-specific coverage; parts of government and private-sector perspectives were underrepresented.

title: Disaster Displacement: Papua New Guinea Country Briefing
organization: Internal Displacement Monitoring Centre and Asian Development Bank
temporal_coverage: Event data through 2021 with prospective risk modelling and a local survey.
methodology: Disaster-displacement database, probabilistic modelling, and survey of 150 displaced and 152 non-displaced people.
limitations: Likely under-recording and one non-representative local survey; geological and climatic hazards require separate treatment.
